blocks.html:
This method creates a shipping option. It sends a request to the
[Create Shipping Option](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#shipping-options\_postshippingoptions)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the shipping option to create.

children.name: name
children.description:
The name of the shipping option. Customers can
view this name during checkout.

children.name: service_zone_id
children.description:
The ID of the service zone that the shipping option belongs to.

Learn more in the [Shipping Options](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#service-zone-restrictions)
documentation.

children.name: shipping_profile_id
children.description:
The ID of the shipping profile that the shipping option belongs to.

Learn more in the [Shipping Options](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#shipping-profile-and-types)
documentation.

children.name: data
children.description:
Additional data that is useful for third-party fulfillment providers
that process fulfillments for the shipping option.

Learn more in the [Shipping Options](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#data-property)
documentation.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: The ID of the fulfillment provider that the shipping option belongs to.

children.name: type
children.description:
The type of shipping option.

Learn more in the [Shipping Option](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#shipping-profile-and-types)
documentation.

children.name: label
children.description: The label of the shipping option type.

children.name: description
children.description: The description of the shipping option type.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the shipping option type.

children.name: type_id
children.description:
The ID of the type of shipping option.

Learn more in the [Shipping Option](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#shipping-profile-and-types)
documentation.

children.name: rules
children.description:
The rules of the shipping option.

Learn more in the [Shipping Option Rules](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#shipping-option-rules)
documentation.

children.name: operator
children.description: The operator of the shipping option rule.

children.name: attribute
children.description: The attribute of the shipping option rule.

children.name: value
children.description: The value of the shipping option rule.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the shipping option.

children.name: price_type
children.description:
The shipping option's price type. `flat` indicates that the price is a fixed
amount set in the `prices` property.

children.name: prices
children.description: The shipping option's prices, each for a different currency or region.

children.name: rules
children.description:
The rules of the shipping option price that
indicate when the price should be applied.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of the shipping option price.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount of the shipping option price.

children.name: region_id
children.description: The ID of the region that the shipping option price belongs to.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the shipping option.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: shipping_option
children.description: The shipping option's details.

children.name: id
children.description: The shipping option's ID.

children.name: name
children.description:
The shipping option's name. Customers can
see this name during checkout.

children.name: price_type
children.description:
The type of the shipping option's price:

- `flat`: the price is a fixed amount stored in the `prices` property.
- `calculated`: the price is calculated during checkout by the shipping option's fulfillment provider, so the `prices` property is empty.

children.name: service_zone_id
children.description:
The ID of the service zone that the shipping option belongs to.

Learn more in the [Shipping Options](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#service-zone-restrictions)
documentation.
